# Release Astronomical 0.2.64
Astronomical 0.2.64 is a maintenance release for the Stable channel that improves session restore performance and hardens the K2 Horizon MoVA model.
## What's new - **Faster prompt-cache restore.** Restoring a saved conversation no longer rebuilds the cached context one block at a time. Restoring long sessions — the ones that cache the most — completes noticeably faster, with fewer GPU stalls during the restore handshake. - **K2 Horizon MoVA prefill fix.** Chunked generation no longer attends over tokens it should not, so token probabilities stay stable no matter how a long prompt is split into chunks. - **K2 Horizon MoVA hardening.** Unsupported or misconfigured model artifacts are now rejected early with a clear message instead of failing later, and the model's tool-call JSON parsing is more robust.
## Compatibility This release requires the existing public model artifacts. No configuration or model files changed.
## Your data is preserved Existing saved sessions and prompt caches remain valid and unchanged; no action is required on your part.
## Distribution This build is code-signed, notarized, and distributed as a DMG from the standard public download link and via the Sparkle signed update feed.
